'''Coral Ohah''' was one of the directors of [[Sleeft Docking Bay Maintenance]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. When a mixup resulted in [[Angor Farn]] receiving a shipment of [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] parts stolen from the [[Notsub Shipping Company]], Ohah coordinated the effort to find Farn and retrieve the goods.<ref name="BL" />
